notes: Units: Settings → Display now has Weight (kg or lb), Distance (metres or feet), Temperature (°C or °F) and Pressure (hPa or inHg).
The Performance window, the Flights and Service pages and the text TechLog writes follow them. In the Performance window the temperature and QNH are typed in the unit you chose.
TechLog still keeps and calculates in kg, metres, °C and hPa, and Fenix is asked in those. EGT, FLEX, speeds and heights are unchanged.
Fixed: the landing card on the Flights page showed the weight without a unit, and the centreline offset was always in metres.
